newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mingly at all-time high on earnings hopes.
newsitem.headline: Mingly at all-time high on earnings hopes.

text.p: Shares of property and hotel services group Mingly Corp Ltd hit an all-time high of HK$1.96 per share on Tuesday morning on good responses to recent flat sales, brokers said.
Mingly was up HK$0.10, or 5.46 percent, at HK$1.93 at midday on volume of 5.91 million shares worth HK$11.36 million.

Buying was fueled by anticipation of a stronger profit contribution from subsidiary HKR International Ltd in view of the overwhelming response of HKR's latest flat sales in Discovery Park, said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
